jobs.description:
Job Posting: Research Data Specialist II



Department of Developmental Services \- Headquarters


JC\-524873* 

Research Data Specialist II
  

RESEARCH DATA SPECIALIST II
$7,640\.00 \- $9,561\.00 per Month
  

New to State candidates will be hired into the minimum salary of the classification or minimum of alternate range when applicable.


**Final Filing Date:** **8/2/2026**


### **Job Description and Duties**


The Research Data Specialist II (RDS II) independently performs technical research and statistical work necessary to accomplish the objectives and tasks of the Department of Developmental Services (Department). The RDS II collects, validates, compiles, analyzes and interprets data provided by other departmental units and regional centers (RCs). The RDS II is responsible for complex technical research functions related to department programs, including Employment Services, and conducts point\-in\-time, trend and multivariate analysis of consumer data on a wide range of topics related to services provided through the State’s network of developmental services. The RDS II must have a strong understanding of research and statistical methods.  

  

  

***Effective July 1, 2025, State employees are subject to a salary reduction of three percent in exchange for five hours per month of the Personal Leave.***
You will find additional information about the job in the **Duty Statement**.


### **Working Conditions**


Under Government Code 14200, this position is a hybrid, in\-office/telework position, and may be subject to change. Incumbent can be required to report to the office, or any designated location at any time. Telework agreements can be modified and/or cancelled at any time.
  

  

Pursuant to California Government Code requirements, candidates must be residents of the State of California at the time of appointment.
  

  

All commute expenses to the reporting location will be the responsibility of the selected candidate.  

This position requires lawful authorization to work in the United States. The Department does not sponsor employment visas for this position.
  

  

This position requires the incumbent to maintain consistent and regular attendance, communicate effectively while working with the public, community members, management, staff, and control agencies; develop and maintain knowledge and skills related to specific tasks, methodologies, materials, tools and equipment; complete assignments in a timely and efficient manner; and adhere to departmental policies and procedures.

### **Department Information**


The California Department of Developmental Services (Department) is the agency through which the State of California provides services and supports to individuals with developmental disabilities.  

These disabilities include intellectual disability, cerebral palsy, epilepsy, autism and related conditions. Services are provided through state\-operated developmental centers and community facilities, and contracts with 21 nonprofit regional centers. The regional centers serve as a local resource to help find and access the services and supports available to individuals with developmental disabilities and their families.  

The Department is located in a modern, sustainable and innovative office building at 1215 “O” Street, Sacramento, California. Some amenities of the building include:
* First floor retail space (separate access from 12th Street)
* Café with multiple vendors
* Outdoor seating for meal breaks
* Employee fitness center which includes a yoga studio, cardio equipment and weights
* Plaza area with kitchenette on each floor
* Lactation rooms
Department Website: http://www.dds.ca.gov
### **Special Requirements**


**The Statement of Qualifications (SOQ) must be numbered in the same order as the following areas, typed in 12\-point Arial font, single spaced, and be no more than two pages in length. Applicants who fail to answer the questions or submit an SOQ may not be considered.**  

* **Describe the most advanced project where you used Python and/or SQL. What challenges did you face, and how did you overcome them?**

  

* **Describe your experience automating reporting using Python and SQL. If you used additional tools or technologies (such as dashboards, APIs, or workflow tools), explain how they supported your work.**

  

* **Describe a time when you tracked and monitored the performance of a program, project, or initiative. How did you work collaboratively to understand goals and requirements? how did you ensure they were clear and usable by others?**

  

  

If you are using list eligibility from an on\-line exam to qualify for this position, you MUST include with your application any documentation (i.e., copy of transcript, degree, license, etc.) to verify meeting the MQ’s or you may not be considered for the position.
  

The MQs will be verified prior to interview and/or appointment. If it is determined that an applicant does not meet the MQs of the classification, the applicant may not be considered and withheld from the eligible list.  

  

### **Application Instructions**

jobs.title: Civic Data Analyst (Sustainable Mobility)
jobs.description:
### **Description**

  

Alta Planning \+ Design seeks a **Civic Data Analyst (Sustainable Mobility)** for our **Los Angeles** office. This position is a great opportunity for someone who believes in the importance of active, multimodal, and sustainable transportation and who is interested in growing their career as a professional working at the intersection of civic data and sustainability. If you are looking to join an innovative organization and do work that connects people to places while advancing social justice, safety, and environmental resilience, apply with Alta today!  

  

**About Alta**  

  

Alta is a mission\-driven company working to mitigate climate change and advance safety and social justice by shaping sustainable, people\-centered communities. We bring together expertise across planning, design, engineering, education and encouragement programs, and community engagement to help communities thrive. Our work is grounded in the belief that how places are designed and experienced has a profound impact on equity, health, and opportunity—and that people should always be at the heart of those decisions.
  

Founded in 1996, Alta was at the forefront of the active transportation movement and has spent nearly 30 years partnering with communities to imagine a more connected, resilient, and inclusive future. Today, with more than 225 staff across the United States and beyond, we are a global leader in creating environments that support everyday life, strengthen human connection, and respond to the challenges of a changing world. Alta offers the opportunity to collaborate across disciplines, contribute to meaningful work at every scale, and be part of a team committed to making lasting, positive change for people and the places they call home.### **Day to Day**

  

Serve as a technical expert and analyst across various disciplines, project types, and regions. Develop prototypes of repeatable analysis in R, Python, and GIS to advance place\-based sustainable transportation solutions. Over time, foster an entrepreneurial approach to analysis through staff training, research, tool development, and custom web applications.  

Engage across Alta’s disciplines to understand data analytics needs, priorities, and expectations, fostering a data\-informed decision\-making culture. Lead the development of new analytical products that align with the firm's objectives and the multidisciplinary nature of the practice. Collaborate closely with planners, designers, and engineers in tasks related to data analysis and visualization, ensuring the developed solutions bring valuable mobility insights and can scale organization wide.  

Delve into data analysis and visualization components of client projects and R\&D efforts, employing complex methodologies. Address mobility and access challenges through innovative analytical solutions, and articulate data\-driven narratives effectively through reports, technical memos, and presentations. Be proactive in identifying labor\-intensive processes and analysis, exploring avenues to streamline and automate them to create organization\-wide value Work on a range of projects including active transportation plans, safety action plans, complete streets planning, safe routes to school, new mobility plans, and economic benefit studies. Each day, you will keep a community\-focused perspective by pushing forward solutions that help communities inform narratives about people, address multifaceted community goals, prepare communities for change, and build a more just transportation system.### **Qualifications**

  

**Required**  

  

This position requires a combination of skills, experience and education including, but not limited to* Bachelor’s Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science or another quantitative field with demonstrated experience in the transportation planning field, OR a Bachelor’s Degree in Planning, Landscape Architecture, Environmental Sciences, or Engineering with some experience in the software development and/or data science fields.
* **Proficiency in Python and/or R, SQL**
* **Proficiency in Quantitative Analysis:** A solid background in data analysis, cross tabulation, and data interpretation is essential. Candidates should be able to apply data driven techniques to inform evidence\-based decision\-making in planning and design contexts.
* Strong understanding of databases, GIS, coding, and familiarity with transportation planning at an advanced level.
* GIS Proficiency \- both open\-source (PostGIS, QGIS, geopandas, etc.) and the ESRI suite (ArcGISPro, Spatial Analyst, Network Analyst, etc.).
* Ability to create informative data visualizations through code (e.g. D3, ggplot, matplotlib, plotly, kepler.gl, etc.).
* Experience designing, implementing, and documenting analytical solutions using code. Ability to execute an analysis entirely with code.
* Data specifications \& database acronyms like OSM, MDS, GTFS, GBFS, GPS, CDS don’t scare you.
* Proficient in MS Excel, Word, PowerPoint, similar products.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

There are a number of additional skills, experience, and education that would be beneficial to this position including, but not limited to:* Master’s Degree in Urban Planning, Statistics, Data Science, Engineering, Math, or Social Sciences
* 1\+ years of experience in a consulting environment or public entity. You have experience working on responses to public sector requests for proposals.
* AICP Certification.
* Experience using Deltek VantagePoint.
* Active participation in industry\-relevant professional associations and committees.
* Demonstrated work of applied statistics or machine learning techniques to transportation challenges.
* Basic familiarity with deploying analytical solutions over the web with the use of Flask, Django, Fast\-API, Tableau, PowerBI, ArcGIS Enterprise, or R\-Shiny.

  

### **What We Offer**

 **Flexible Schedule**
Alta offers a flexible, hybrid work

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager/Environmental Scientist
jobs.description:
Bring your curiosity and determination to make a positive impact on the future of transport, and we’ll help you go all the way!


Join our team of globally connected specialists to help solve complex transport challenges and experience groundbreaking projects from idea to delivery, and beyond.


Our pledge to you.


Join GHD.


**Who are we looking for?**

The US West Environment Market is a critical component of GHD’s overall growth strategy in Americas. The US West Region is looking to bring onboard a motivated **Senior Project Manager/Environmental Scientist** to lead expansion of GHD’s Contamination, Assessment and Remediation practice in the West. This position is located in our **Irvine, Ca** office.


The Contamination Assessment \& Remediation business focuses on the identification and investigation of contaminants and their impacts on soil, groundwater, surface water, and soil vapor/air. We also select, design and implement effective and sustainable remedial solutions for contaminated sites. We offer expertise with known and emerging contaminants such as hydrocarbons, solvents, PFAS, nutrients, metals, dioxins and furans, acidity and explosives.


Our clients are a mix of public and private organizations in the Petroleum, Oil, Gas, Government (Federal, State, Municipal), Chemical and Manufacturing, Mining, Energy, Transport, Emergency Services, Agriculture, Developers and Legal sectors.


As S **enior Project Manager/Environmental Scientist** you will provide technical and delivery leadership of the CAR projects for our clients throughout the West. This position will work from our **Irvine, CA** office. Mentorship and development of junior staff is a critical component of the role. There is opportunity for travel to project sites in other areas and to provide desktop support for projects in other regions, domestically and internationally.


Bring your curiosity and passion to the technical challenges we solve at GHD. Then see how everyone gets behind you.


With commitment, there’s no idea too big, no dream too far. We strive to create opportunity for all. Giving you leading training and development programs to accelerate your growth.


**Come and see where your career can take you and the impact your commitment can make.**

**Our Hybrid Work Model:** Be part of the dynamic culture! Our workplace thrives on a hybrid model, combining in\-office collaboration and flexibility. Join us in the office three days a week to contribute, connect and excel in our vibrant environment.


**Specific responsibilities in this role will include:**

* **Data Collection and Analysis:** Conduct research using primary data sources, and select information needed for the analysis of key themes and trends.
* **Health, Safety, and Environment:** Monitor and review performance against health, safety, and environment (HSE) key performance indicators (KPIs) and patterns of behavior within the area of responsibility. Take action to improve performance and to resolve noncompliance with the organization's HSE policies, procedures, and mandatory instructions.
* **Personal Capability Building:** Develop own capabilities by participating in assessment and development planning activities as well as formal and informal training and coaching; gain or maintain external professional accreditation, where relevant, to improve performance and fulfill personal potential. Maintain an in\-depth understanding of technology, external regulation, and industry best practices through ongoing education, attending conferences, and reading specialist media.
* **Client \& Customer Management (External):** Manage important client relationships with guidance from senior colleagues, or oversee relationship management with a group of more transactional clients and customers.
* **Environmental Impact Assessment:** Coordinate and deliver environmental impact assessment projects, maintaining accuracy and adherence to project timelines.
* **Solutions Analysis:** Analyze specific problems and issues to find the best solutions. Solutions could be technical or professional in nature.
* **Project Management:** Deliver small\- or medium\-scale projects while working within an established program management plan.
* **Insights and Reporting:** Prepare and coordinate the completion of various data and analytics reports.
* **Environmental Risk Management:** Oversee the environmental risk management processes, ensuring the organization's operations have minimal detrimental impact on the environment.
* **Request for Bid Solicitation/Proposal/Tender Response:** Gather information and resources, draft and complete proposals, and fulfill all process requirements (in terms of deadlines, documentation, etc.) in response to bid solicitations, request for proposal, and request for tender to create the best chance of being awarded the contract.
* **Community of Practice Management:** Participate in and contribute to a community of practice in a defined area of expertise or consulting to build own capability and develop innovative practice among colleagues.

**Education**

* Bachelor's Degree in Geology or equivalent field.
* Master's Degree preferred.

**Experience**

* **Minimum 10** years experience in the field
* PG preferred

**EEO Statement US:** As a multicultural organization, we encourage individual achievement and recognize the strength of a diverse workforce. GHD is an equal opportunity employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified employees and applicants without regard to race, creed, religion, national origin, citizenship, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, marital status or veteran status.


Salary Range: $85,000\-$145,000 based on experience

jobs.description:
**Benefits:**
* Bonus based on performance
* Opportunity for advancement
* Training \& development
**Construction / Restoration\_Project Coordinator**
===================================================



  

**Paul Davis Restoration – East San Gabriel Valley**  

  

About Us  

Paul Davis Restoration is a fast\-growing restoration and reconstruction company specializing in water, fire, mold, and environmental restoration. We pride ourselves on exceptional customer service, quick response times, and delivering high\-quality work. We’re looking for someone who enjoys solving problems, staying organized, and helping our project managers operate more efficiently.  

**Position Summary:**  

We’re seeking a highly organized **Operations \& Procurement Coordinator** to support our Project Managers by handling the administrative and procurement tasks that keep our projects moving.  

This position is ideal for someone who enjoys making phone calls, researching vendors, negotiating pricing, coordinating schedules, and ensuring that every project has the resources it needs to stay on schedule.  

Your success will allow our Project Managers to focus on managing customers, field operations, and project execution.  

**Responsibilities:**  

***Vendor \& Subcontractor Management:***  

* Research and recruit qualified subcontractors
* Verify licenses, insurance, and certifications
* Obtain competitive bids and pricing
* Maintain an organized subcontractor database
* Build relationships with new trade partners
* Coordinate subcontractor scheduling

  

***Material Procurement:***  

* Source construction and restoration materials
* Compare pricing from multiple suppliers
* Place purchase orders
* Coordinate deliveries to job sites
* Track backorders and resolve supply issues
* Research alternative products when necessary

  

***Project Coordination:***  

* Assist Project Managers with administrative tasks
* Coordinate inspections and deliveries
* Follow up with vendors and subcontractors
* Update project management software
* Organize project documentation
* Track purchase orders and invoices

  

***Office Support:***  

* Answer vendor inquiries
* Make outbound calls
* Research products and equipment
* Obtain product specifications and safety data sheets
* Assist with special projects as assigned

  

**Qualifications:**  

* Strong organizational skills
* Excellent communication skills
* Comfortable making frequent phone calls
* Strong computer skills (Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, Excel)
* Ability to manage multiple priorities
* Detail\-oriented and dependable
* Problem\-solving mindset

  

**Preferred (but not required):**  

* Construction, restoration, or procurement experience
* Experience with Xactimate, Dash, Encircle, or other construction software
* Purchasing or vendor management experience

  

**What We’re Looking For:**  


  

We’re looking for someone who:  


  

* Takes initiative without waiting to be told what to do.
* Enjoys solving problems.
* Can juggle multiple tasks without losing attention to detail.
* Is persistent when following up with vendors and subcontractors.
* Wants to grow with a rapidly expanding company.

  


**Compensation:**  


  

* Competitive salary based on experience
* Paid holidays
* Paid time off
* Opportunities for advancement
* Training and professional development

  


**Why Join Us?**  


  

At Paul Davis Restoration, you’ll be part of a growing team where your work directly impacts the success of every project. You’ll have the opportunity to build relationships with vendors, improve company operations, and grow into larger leadership responsibilities as the company continues to expand.  

If you’re organized, resourceful, and enjoy keeping projects moving behind the scenes, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Program Coordinator Full-Time
jobs.description:
**ESSENTIAL DUTIES:**

* Provides supervision, guidance, and support to counselors in both the Substance Use Prevention Program (SUPP), and the Drug and Alcohol Intervention Services for Youth (DAISY) programs.
* Participates in interviews, hiring, and evaluation of employees.
* Facilitates regular supervision individually and in group settings with employees.
* Participates in contracted partner meetings, such as probation department staff and school site/district staff.
* Establishes and maintains a positive working relationship with school personnel, probation department, and other collaborating agencies leads.
* Researches and stays up to date on substance use trends, and conducts drug and alcohol training sessions/presentations.
* Facilitates and regularly updates curricula such as Vape Offense Workshop, and Youth Alternatives to Violence (YATV), The Seven Challenges, and The Brief Challenges.
* Maintains fidelity binder for The Seven Challenges and leads quarterly supervision to ensure counselors maintain their fidelity binders and requirements.
* Coordinates and participates in prevention activities at the school and/or in the community.
* Assists and supports Drug Resource Specialists, maintaining effective and open communication with them.
* Assists and supports the Program Officer on a variety of projects, maintaining effective and open communication.
* Provides case management and advocacy.
* Offers information and referrals to community resources.
* Collaborates with other agencies.
* Generates, collects, and prepares data/reports for agency contractor use/evaluation.
* Promotes harm reduction and drug\-free choices, healthy relationships, and positive social\-emotional connections.
* Participates in agency outreach and marketing efforts.
* Performs administrative functions as delegated by the Program Officer.
* Schedules and facilitates training for new counselors.
* Maintains and updates master forms on Google Drive.
* Other duties as assigned.

 **MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:** The Program Coordinator position requires extensive knowledge of leadership, substance abuse prevention, experience working with youth, families and schools, counseling, case management, computer competence (Microsoft Office), organizational, administrative, planning, and excellent written and verbal skills. The candidate must be able to work independently and as member of team. The candidate must also be able to work closely with school and probation staff while staying connected to CHS and the supervisor to successfully implement program objectives and develop strong, healthy, ongoing relationships with staff, clients, and partnering agencies.


Candidates for this position must have a Bachelor’s Degree in Counseling, Psychology or Social. Work and three years related work and leadership experience. The equivalent combination of education and related experience may be substituted for the above. Experience in program development is highly desired. Preference will be given to bilingual/biliterate/bi\-cultural candidates.

* California driver’s license is required.
* Auto insurance is required.
* CPR/First Aid is required.

 **PHYSICAL EFFORT:**

* Physical, mental and emotional stamina to perform the duties and responsibilities of the position
* Mental acuity to collect and interpret data, evaluate, reason, define problems, establish facts, draw valid conclusions, make valid judgments and decisions
* Manual dexterity sufficient to write, use the telephone, computer, calculator and office machines at required speed and accuracy
* Vision sufficient to read handwritten and printed materials and the display screen of various office equipment and machines
* Hearing sufficient to communicate in person and hold telephone conversations in the normal range
* Speaking ability in an understandable voice with sufficient volume to be heard in normal conversational distances on the telephone and addressing groups
* Physical stamina sufficient to sustain light to medium physical labor for up to 8 hours, sit and/or walk for prolonged periods of time
* Physical mobility sufficient to move about the work environment for sustained periods of time on hard flooring, climb slopes, stairs, ramps and to respond to emergency situations
* Physical strength sufficient to periodically lift, carry, push and/or pull 40 pounds of materials or supplies; occasionally lift, carry, push and/or pull more than 40 pounds with assistance

  

Salary $64,840 – $78,813/annually D.O.E, additional 5% bilingual stipend

jobs.title: Residential Construction Project Coordinator (Industry specific experience required)
jobs.description:
Dyna Builders is a Seattle\-based designer and builder of high\-quality, custom homes. Our projects traverse aesthetic boundaries and are not limited to a particular style; instead, we respect a home's character and strive to make it the best it can be. We specialize in high\-end residential and floating home design and construction.

**Summary Description:**

Under the overall direction of the PM, the PC coordinates work and communication with architects, designers, on\-site Superintendent(s), subcontractors, vendors, and directly with the clients, to ensure each project in the portfolio runs smoothly, professionally, on\-time, and within the established budget. We have an open office environment, and the PC is required to visit the Dyna project sites throughout the Seattle area and interact directly with Dyna clients and other members of the Dyna team, as needed.

**Essential Functions, Duties \& Responsibilities:**

· Works with Dyna’s team of PMs to coordinate the day\-to\-day logistics of each project including direct interactions with Dyna clients, sometimes in their homes, sometimes at the Dyna office.

· Provides semi\-monthly labor summaries and submit to PM within a day to ensure efficient and timely client billings.

· Prepares and executes meeting notes and coordinates with responsible parties for follow\-up items. Ensures meeting minute recaps are sent to the PMs within two days, and then issued to the project’s team (Client, architect, interior designer) within three days.

· Coordinate “Construction Online” tasks and organization; creating project folders, uploading final finish schedules and documents, including weekly meeting notes. Also includes tracking of daily superintendent reports, weekly project pictures and safety documentation. Inform PM of deficiencies.

· Coordinate w/ PM and Accounts Payable in setting up new vendor \& subcontractor agreements before subcontractor performs any work. Accounts payable will ensure all updated agreements/contracts have current certificate of insurance, W\-9 documentation. The PC may follow these steps if they are initiating a vendor/subcontractor agreement.

· Catalogs and monitors delivery of materials once materials have been ordered. Manages material delivery schedules; identify any issues that don’t conform to plan specifications or damage and report these issues to the PM. Arrange for material delivery via the Dyna driver whenever possible, or deliver materials to jobsite directly using personal vehicle.

· Provide continuous weekly status updates to PM on fixtures and finishes schedules.

· Provide Client Homeowner Manual at project’s Substantial Completion timeframe, or once Client moves into home.

· Performs other related duties as assigned, specifically under the supervision of the PM Department.

· QuickBooks Time Sheets: Stays current with daily input of hours and detailed notes of work performed on each project.

· Assist PM within building the budget during Pre\-Construction phase, which includes take\-offs and sourcing bids on finishes, plumbing fixtures, electrical fixtures, door \& cabinet hardware, cabinetry, bath accessories, etc. This includes coordination with vendors and subs to attain budget costs for material \& labor.

· Creates new Invoice and Labor Summary excel documents at project start up, for billings.

· Creates any finish and fixture schedules not provided by the designer, for procurement and tracking purposes.

· Manages job mobilization start up tasks, including porta potty scheduling, water jug delivery, no parking street signs, on\-site job safety signs, neighborhood letters, client contact set up, Construction Online project set up, and creating PM/Super Binders.

· Sends documents and contracts on DocuSign at all phases of project; Pre\-Construction Subcontracts, Master Contract, Change Orders, Substantial Completion documents, etc. Saves signed contracts to server and helps manage deliverables with PM.

· Coordinate with Interior Designer or Architect if VE (value engineering) alternatives are needed to stay within budget.

· Order samples of finishes/hardware/materials if requested by Client or PM.

· Confirm with Interior Designer that specified fixtures/hardware include all parts \& pieces required for installation (i.e., Rough in parts, electrical drivers, accessory parts).

· Coordinates the selection and procurement of non\-decorative fixtures in a project. This includes but is not limited to architectural lighting (can lights, LED lighting, puck lights, wall lights), outlets, and certain door/cabinet hardware.

· Helps PM schedule subcontractors on site. For example, scheduling install of slabs, tile, wallpaper, closet systems, shower glass, mirrors, appliances. Includes managing subcontractors’ scope of work based on specifications \& design requirements.

· Work alongside Service Department on past project’s warranty work. Serve as active PC/PM on Service Department smaller projects.

· Coordinate project permitting for street use, Right of Way, parking signs, and restricted access with the City of Seattle (SDIC). PC is expected to maintain their own account on the SDCI website for permitting needs.

**Knowledge, Skills \& Experience:**

· Must possess exceptional diplomatic skills, including the ability to communicate clearly and exercise an impeccably professional demeanor on the phone and in person, with customers, vendors, and colleagues at all levels.

· Capability to plan and organize time and resources efficiently in a fast\-paced, high\-volume environment.

· Experience working in a similar role, preferably 1\-2 years in the residential construction industry.

· Ability to read and interpret construction plans.

· Moderate to advanced computer skills, including Word, Excel or Mac Numbers, Mac/Apple environment, Mac experience preferred, but not required.

· An associate degree is preferred, additional education greatly preferred. We recognize that life experience can also b

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
**Circuit Clinical®** is on a mission to transform the way people find, choose, and participate in clinical research.

We are searching for a part\-time **Data Analyst** to join our team!

Circuit Clinical was ranked 20th nationally for **Best Workplaces for Innovators by Fast Company®** and was named an **Inc. Magazine® Best Workplaces 2021**. Topping a long list of innovation and startup awards over the last 5 years – including winning **SCOPE**’s Participant Engagement Award and winning at **43North** \- Circuit recently won **Fast Company’s World Changing Ideas™ Award.**

Our award\-winning culture is grounded on a belief in the values of **transparency, inclusion, accountability, performance, talent seeking, \& continuous learning**. We live these values every day and we’re looking for a leader who embodies them. Our focus is on building an incredible, hard charging Team and on providing them with the opportunity to do the best work of their careers. In short, we’re motivated to take on the hardest problems in the development of new medicines – this is **Work That Matters.**

To accomplish our Mission, we know we must recruit the most dynamic, mission\-driven, empathetic, and passionate leaders in our industry. **That’s where you come in!**

**What We Offer:**

If you’ve been looking for a chance to work with an amazing, highly motivated team and to have direct impact in building a transformative clinical trials company every day – that is exactly what we’re offering. We provide competitive benefits and an environment focused on helping you grow personally and professionally.

**What You Will Bring to Circuit Clinical:**

As our **Accounts Receivable Specialist** you will support data management, reporting, and analytics activities across clinical research operations. You will be responsible for collecting, cleaning, validating, and analyzing data from Electronic Health Records (EHRs), clinical research systems, and other healthcare data sources.

**Essential Responsibilities:**

* Extract, compile, and organize data from EHR systems and clinical research platforms.
* Perform data quality audits to identify missing, inaccurate, or duplicate records.
* Validate datasets against source documentation and established business rules.
* Maintain data integrity and consistency across multiple systems.

**Data Analysis \& Reporting**

* Analyze healthcare and clinical research data to identify trends, patterns, and operational insights.
* Create and maintain reports, dashboards, and ad hoc analyses using Excel and other reporting tools.
* Support patient population identification and feasibility assessments for clinical research studies.
* Assist with KPI tracking and operational reporting for research activities.

**Data Management**

* Clean and transform data from multiple sources into usable formats.
* Support data migration, integration, and reconciliation projects.
* Document data definitions, workflows, and standard operating procedures.
* Maintain confidentiality and compliance with HIPAA and organizational privacy requirements.

**Collaboration**

* Work with clinical operations, research coordinators, informatics teams, and healthcare partners to fulfill data requests.
* Assist in troubleshooting data discrepancies and identifying process improvements.
* Participate in projects involving EHR optimization, reporting automation, and clinical informatics initiatives.

**Your Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Health Informatics, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Public Health, or related field.
* Experience supporting clinical research studies or research operations.
* Experience with Power BI, Tableau, SQL, Salesforce, CRIO, REDCap, or other clinical/research technology platforms.
* Knowledge of HIPAA, GCP (Good Clinical Practice), and healthcare data privacy requirements.
* Exposure to healthcare quality, population health, or clinical research analytics.

**Who You Are:** 

We prize 4 traits above all others:

**Hungry:** we like people who are ambitious for themselves AND for our Mission and for each other – we’ll all win together and that takes real drive

**Happy:** we seek pragmatic optimists – pessimism and ironic dispositions, especially in leadership can kill startups – we seek those who know the world can be improved by those who work hard and smart to change it

**Humble:** not the false “I’m not really anything” kind of modesty – we like swagger! But we prize people who are confident who know they are great, and so is everyone around them… and act accordingly

**Smart:** there are a LOT of smart people here… but smart is last for a reason. We want those kinds of smart people who can collaborate and respect the intelligence of others.

**The other fine print:** 

**Location:** This position is remote. We are hiring in the following states: NY, NJ, PA, KY, MO, WI.

**Exemption status:** Part time, non\-exempt, 20\-25 hours per week.

**Physical requirements:** the following physical requirements described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions: Regularly required to sit; use hands; reach with hands and arms; talk and hear. Specific vision abilities include close vision

**Other duties:** the duties and responsibilities described are not a comprehensive list and that additional tasks may be assigned to the employee from time to time; or, the scope of the job may change as necessitated by business demands

Pay: $25\.00 \- $35\.00 per hour

Work Location: Remote

new_jobs.title: Civic Data Analyst (Sustainable Mobility)
new_jobs.description:
### **Description**

  

Alta Planning \+ Design seeks a **Civic Data Analyst (Sustainable Mobility)** for our **Los Angeles** office. This position is a great opportunity for someone who believes in the importance of active, multimodal, and sustainable transportation and who is interested in growing their career as a professional working at the intersection of civic data and sustainability. If you are looking to join an innovative organization and do work that connects people to places while advancing social justice, safety, and environmental resilience, apply with Alta today!  

  

**About Alta**  

  

Alta is a mission\-driven company working to mitigate climate change and advance safety and social justice by shaping sustainable, people\-centered communities. We bring together expertise across planning, design, engineering, education and encouragement programs, and community engagement to help communities thrive. Our work is grounded in the belief that how places are designed and experienced has a profound impact on equity, health, and opportunity—and that people should always be at the heart of those decisions.
  

Founded in 1996, Alta was at the forefront of the active transportation movement and has spent nearly 30 years partnering with communities to imagine a more connected, resilient, and inclusive future. Today, with more than 225 staff across the United States and beyond, we are a global leader in creating environments that support everyday life, strengthen human connection, and respond to the challenges of a changing world. Alta offers the opportunity to collaborate across disciplines, contribute to meaningful work at every scale, and be part of a team committed to making lasting, positive change for people and the places they call home.### **Day to Day**

  

Serve as a technical expert and analyst across various disciplines, project types, and regions. Develop prototypes of repeatable analysis in R, Python, and GIS to advance place\-based sustainable transportation solutions. Over time, foster an entrepreneurial approach to analysis through staff training, research, tool development, and custom web applications.  

Engage across Alta’s disciplines to understand data analytics needs, priorities, and expectations, fostering a data\-informed decision\-making culture. Lead the development of new analytical products that align with the firm's objectives and the multidisciplinary nature of the practice. Collaborate closely with planners, designers, and engineers in tasks related to data analysis and visualization, ensuring the developed solutions bring valuable mobility insights and can scale organization wide.  

Delve into data analysis and visualization components of client projects and R\&D efforts, employing complex methodologies. Address mobility and access challenges through innovative analytical solutions, and articulate data\-driven narratives effectively through reports, technical memos, and presentations. Be proactive in identifying labor\-intensive processes and analysis, exploring avenues to streamline and automate them to create organization\-wide value Work on a range of projects including active transportation plans, safety action plans, complete streets planning, safe routes to school, new mobility plans, and economic benefit studies. Each day, you will keep a community\-focused perspective by pushing forward solutions that help communities inform narratives about people, address multifaceted community goals, prepare communities for change, and build a more just transportation system.### **Qualifications**

  

**Required**  

  

This position requires a combination of skills, experience and education including, but not limited to* Bachelor’s Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science or another quantitative field with demonstrated experience in the transportation planning field, OR a Bachelor’s Degree in Planning, Landscape Architecture, Environmental Sciences, or Engineering with some experience in the software development and/or data science fields.
* **Proficiency in Python and/or R, SQL**
* **Proficiency in Quantitative Analysis:** A solid background in data analysis, cross tabulation, and data interpretation is essential. Candidates should be able to apply data driven techniques to inform evidence\-based decision\-making in planning and design contexts.
* Strong understanding of databases, GIS, coding, and familiarity with transportation planning at an advanced level.
* GIS Proficiency \- both open\-source (PostGIS, QGIS, geopandas, etc.) and the ESRI suite (ArcGISPro, Spatial Analyst, Network Analyst, etc.).
* Ability to create informative data visualizations through code (e.g. D3, ggplot, matplotlib, plotly, kepler.gl, etc.).
* Experience designing, implementing, and documenting analytical solutions using code. Ability to execute an analysis entirely with code.
* Data specifications \& database acronyms like OSM, MDS, GTFS, GBFS, GPS, CDS don’t scare you.
* Proficient in MS Excel, Word, PowerPoint, similar products.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

There are a number of additional skills, experience, and education that would be beneficial to this position including, but not limited to:* Master’s Degree in Urban Planning, Statistics, Data Science, Engineering, Math, or Social Sciences
* 1\+ years of experience in a consulting environment or public entity. You have experience working on responses to public sector requests for proposals.
* AICP Certification.
* Experience using Deltek VantagePoint.
* Active participation in industry\-relevant professional associations and committees.
* Demonstrated work of applied statistics or machine learning techniques to transportation challenges.
* Basic familiarity with deploying analytical solutions over the web with the use of Flask, Django, Fast\-API, Tableau, PowerBI, ArcGIS Enterprise, or R\-Shiny.

  

### **What We Offer**

 **Flexible Schedule**
Alta offers a flexible, hybrid work
